name: Alex Morgan
headline: Senior Software Engineer · Laravel & Vue.js · 8+ years
summary: Senior Software Engineer with 8+ years of building web applications, most recently on subscription billing for a SaaS company. I work mainly in Laravel and Vue.js, enjoy turning legacy code into something the team is happy to change, and care about tests, clear code reviews and shipping in small steps.
highlights: Rebuilt a subscription billing system used by 4,000 businesses, cutting failed renewals by 30%
Led a team of 3 developers through a move from a legacy PHP monolith to Laravel
Introduced automated tests and CI to a codebase that had none, catching regressions before release
